convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load the 'T3_TRIX' custom indicator, and depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing calculations and trade execution logic. Custom indicator buffers and multi-mode signal logic require manual mapping.

other_exits: In 'breakdown' mode: BUY_Close triggered when histogram goes negative; SELL_Close triggered when histogram goes positive
In 'twist' mode: BUY_Close triggered when histogram starts declining; SELL_Close triggered when histogram starts rising
In 'cloudtwist' mode: BUY_Close triggered when UpCloud crosses below DnCloud; SELL_Close triggered when UpCloud crosses above DnCloud

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative MM values (-0.1) = fixed lot size of 0.1; Positive MM values = fraction of deposit. MMMode (LOT, FO, MM) determines lot calculation method when MM is positive.

custom_logic_notes: Three selectable entry algorithms via AlgMode enum: (1) 'breakdown' - histogram crosses zero line using buffer[2] at SignalBar and SignalBar+1; (2) 'twist' - histogram direction change using 3 consecutive buffer[2] values; (3) 'cloudtwist' - signal cloud color change comparing buffer[0] vs buffer[1] crossover. SignalBar=0 allows intrabar recalculation without new bar check. UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime timestamps are set to last bar date + period seconds, used by TradeAlgorithms.mqh for position management. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose boolean inputs act as permission gates for each trade direction and action.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement T3_TRIX custom indicator with T3 smoothing from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh - need to extract the CT3 class logic. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory, GlobalVariableDel_ - all must be reimplemented in Python. The conditional position sizing (negative=lot, positive=deposit fraction) with MarginMode enum must be carefully ported. The three signal modes (breakdown/twist/cloudtwist) map to distinct signal generators. Entry signals use previous bar data (SignalBar default=1) so no lookahead bias. Signal timestamps are used for trade identification - need to map this to Python order management.
